about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Velar D200 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Velar D200 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that sits at the entry point of the Velar diesel line-up alongside the D180 and above the D240 (a higher-output version of the same engine family). It's fitted to the L560-generation Velar, which has been in production since 2017 and received a mid-cycle update in 2024. The AJ200D shares the Ingenium diesel family's well-documented timing chain wear pattern — something we address on every rebuild.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200D engines for every Range Rover Velar D200 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the Velar D200 from 2017 to present (L560 generation). Known for timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution and EGR cooler leaks — see the callout above. We replace worn timing chain components, injector seals, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild. Check Your AJ200D Velar D200 → [link to quote form]
